cues.text: 第十一集 孙悟空学会了吗
上一集 师父答应孙悟空
要教它躲避危险的方法
师父说 有两个方法
它说 我要学七十二变
师父在孙悟空耳边小声地说
孙悟空要认真地练习七十二变
孙悟空学会了七十二变
一天 师父和大家来到外面
师父问 你会飞了吗
会腾云的人一天可以飞过四个海
它说 请您教我腾云的方法
师父说 你刚才打了一个筋斗
晚上 孙悟空认真练习
筋斗云一下子飞到了很远的地方

en_cues.text: Episode 11 Has Sun Wukong learned it

In the last episode
the master promised Sun Wukong
to teach him how to avoid danger
Sun Wukong was very happy
He watched his master carefully
The master said There are two methods
One is the Thirty-Six Transformations

The other is
the Seventy-Two Transformations
Which one do you want to learn
Sun Wukong thought for a moment

He said I want to learn
the Seventy-Two Transformations
Seventy-two is more than thirty-six
The master asked Sun Wukong to come closer

The master spoke softly
into Sun Wukong's ear
Sun Wukong listened for a long time
He now knew how to transform

Sun Wukong had to practice
the Seventy-Two Transformations carefully
Sun Wukong practiced during the day
and also at night
He could turn into a tree
He could also turn into a stone
He could turn into many other things too

Sun Wukong learned
the Seventy-Two Transformations

One day
the master and everyone else went outside
The master asked Can you fly now
Sun Wukong said I can
I will fly and show everyone
Sun Wukong jumped onto a cloud
He walked for a long time
but only traveled three li
He said
Master I can ride clouds now
The master smiled and said
That is not cloud riding
You are just walking on a cloud

Those who can ride clouds
can fly across four seas in a day
Sun Wukong said
That is too hard
Sun Wukong bowed to his master
He said Please teach me how to ride clouds
The master said You just did a somersault
So I will teach you the Somersault Cloud
That night Sun Wukong practiced hard
He did a somersault
and jumped onto the Somersault Cloud

The Somersault Cloud
flew far away in an instant
Sun Wukong learned the Somersault Cloud
